facts.fact: At the start of 2026 Mozambique had three electronic money institutions authorised by the central bank, M-Pesa, e-Mola and M-Kesh, owned by the three mobile operators; the document names no law or rule they are licensed under.
facts.system: Electronic money institution regime (Bank of Mozambique)

facts.fact: The 2026-07-30 report says participation by digital wallet operators in the Metix instant payment system, which integrates banks, microbanks, e-money institutions and other payment service providers, is mandatory; the document does not name the rule or give its date (published date used).
